title.zh-TW: GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 模型上線，支援 Bedrock 並附帶舊版遷移提示
title.en: GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models Launch with Bedrock Support and Legacy Migration Tips

body.zh-TW: 如果你正準備挑選模型處理專案，現在多了 GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 兩款新模型可供切換使用。⟦就像工坊添購了兩台新設備，連接著企業專用線路的廠區能直接啟用，操作台旁還附上了舊機型的換機指引。⟧習慣透過 Amazon Bedrock（AWS 提供的雲端模型託管服務）串接模型的團隊，現在也能直接選用這兩款模型。如果手邊的專案仍在運行舊版模型，也可以參考附帶的遷移提示，順利將工作過渡到新模型。
body.en: If you're picking a model for your project, two new models, GPT-6 Sol and Luna, are now available to switch to. ⟦Picture a workshop that just added two new machines: the facility connected to the dedicated enterprise line can power them on right away, and a replacement guide for the old models sits next to the console.⟧ Teams used to connecting models through Amazon Bedrock (AWS's cloud model hosting service) can now choose these two models directly. If your project still runs on an older model, you can also follow the included migration tips to move your work over to the new models smoothly.

items.original: Added GPT-6 Sol and Luna, including Amazon Bedrock support and migration prompts for older models. (#47332, #47347)

title.zh-TW: 背景伺服器自動啟動，遠端工作階段支援匯入指令
title.en: Background Servers Auto-Start, Remote Sessions Support the Import Command

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟互動式工作階段（與 AI 即時交談的操作階段）時，符合條件的環境現在會自動在背後啟動伺服器。⟦彷彿走進智能廚房時備料烤箱就已自動熱機，以前每次動工都要先手動啟動各台設備，現在一進場就能直接開始；遇到設定規格不合時，控制台還會主動提供調整方案讓你點選修復。⟧萬一伺服器設定與當前環境衝突，畫面會給出修復選項供你選擇，避免操作直接中斷。在遠端連線或本機背景伺服器的工作階段中，你現在也能隨時使用 `/import` 指令。
body.en: When you open an interactive session (a live conversation with the AI), eligible environments now automatically start a server behind the scenes. ⟦It's like walking into a smart kitchen where the prep oven is already warming up: you used to have to manually start every machine before getting to work, but now you can begin the moment you walk in; and when the settings don't match the spec, the console proactively offers adjustment options you can click to fix.⟧ If the server configuration conflicts with your current environment, the screen offers repair options so your work isn't interrupted outright. In sessions running on a remote connection or a local background server, you can now also use the `/import` command at any time.

items.original:
Enabled automatic background-server startup for eligible interactive sessions, with recovery choices when server settings are incompatible. (#47179, #47318)
Made `/import` available in remote sessions and local background-server sessions. (#47317)

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵快速分岔對話，草稿與語音通話切換不中斷
title.en: Fork Conversations with a Shortcut, Drafts and Voice Calls Survive Switching

body.zh-TW: 你正在與 AI 討論專案，如果想開闢新分支探索不同方案，這正是按下 `f` 快捷鍵分岔對話（從既有討論衍生新分支）的時刻。⟦會議室另開一桌討論時，草稿與排隊待談的問題會跟著到新桌；在兩桌之間換位時，耳機裡的通話則持續進行。⟧透過這項功能分岔在其他應用程式中開啟的對話時，你尚未送出的草稿與排隊中的提示詞都會完整保留。當你在不同討論串之間切換時，進行中的語音通話不會被迫中斷。如果在回合結束時你輸入框裡還有未送出的回答，內容會自動恢復到輸入框中，而且不會干擾當前進行中的歷史紀錄搜尋。
body.en: You're discussing a project with the AI, and if you want to open a new branch to explore a different approach, this is the moment to press the `f` shortcut to fork the conversation (spinning a new branch off the existing discussion). ⟦When a meeting room opens a second table for discussion, the drafts and queued questions follow you to the new table; and as you move between the two tables, the call in your headset keeps going.⟧ When you fork a conversation that was opened in another application, your unsent drafts and queued prompts are all preserved intact. As you switch between discussion threads, an ongoing voice call is not forced to disconnect. If you still have an unsubmitted reply in the input box when a turn ends, the content is automatically restored to the input box, without interfering with any history search currently in progress.

items.original:
Added an `f` shortcut to fork conversations open in another app, preserving drafts and queued prompts. (#47185)
Preserved active voice conversations when switching threads. (#47381)
Recovered unsent question answers into the composer when turns end, without disrupting active history searches. (#47422, #47423)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕對話紀錄預設開啟，終端機排版與選取捲動體驗升級
title.en: Fullscreen Conversation History On by Default, Terminal Layout and Selection Scrolling Upgraded

body.zh-TW: 當你需要在終端機裡查閱長篇回應、或是想跨行複製特定段落時，畫面空間與文字選取都很重要。對話紀錄現在預設以全螢幕顯示，並支援按住 Shift 鍵配合點擊來延伸選取文字。⟦跟把粗糙的黑白草稿換成排版講究的印刷手冊一樣，以前數學符號與清單容易擠成一團，現在符號排得整齊，也能拉著尺標連續標記整段文字。⟧畫面渲染也更加細緻，完整支援 Unicode（通用文字編碼）項目符號、核取方塊、對齊方程式與最佳化數學標記。當你在自動螢幕模式下透過 SSH（遠端連線通道）使用 Terminal.app 時，現在能再次使用原生捲動紀錄。終端機也會遵循 tmux（終端機多工工具）的滑鼠設定。
body.en: When you need to read long responses in the terminal or copy a specific passage across lines, screen space and text selection both matter. Conversation history now displays fullscreen by default, and supports holding the Shift key while clicking to extend a text selection. ⟦Think of swapping a rough black-and-white draft for a carefully typeset printed manual: math symbols and lists used to get crammed together, but now the symbols line up neatly, and you can drag along the ruler to mark an entire passage in one go.⟧ Rendering is also more refined, with full support for Unicode (universal text encoding) bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. When you use Terminal.app over SSH (a remote connection channel) in automatic screen mode, native scrollback works again. The terminal also respects the mouse settings of tmux (a terminal multiplexer).

items.original:
Enabled fullscreen transcripts by default and added Shift-click to extend text selections. (#47178, #47414)
Improved terminal rendering with Unicode bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. (#47191, #47322)
Respected tmux mouse settings and restored native scrollback for Terminal.app over SSH in automatic screen mode. (#47399, #47417)

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器路由修復，檔案上傳支援重試並強化連線管制
title.en: Proxy Routing Fixed, File Uploads Gain Retries and Stricter Connection Enforcement

body.zh-TW: 在受管制或需要透過代理伺服器（替你轉發網路請求的中繼主機）連網的環境中，現在網路傳輸更加可靠且安全。⟦好比替物流轉運站加裝智慧閘門與重送輸送帶，以前遇到訊號微弱包裹就容易掉單、轉運路線也偶爾走錯，現在傳送失敗會自動重試且等候時間更長，遇到安全通行證被撤銷時也會立刻阻斷違規包裹。⟧過去即時連線與獨立網路搜尋在遇到轉址時，代理伺服器路由可能走錯，這個問題已經修好。上傳檔案時若遇到暫時性網路故障會自動重試，上傳逾時時間也延長至五分鐘。所有轉址與進行中的 HTTP（網頁傳輸規則）連線都會嚴格落實網路限制。WebSocket（即時雙向連線）也一樣；一旦安全規則變更撤銷了權限，連線會立刻被主動中斷。
body.en: In managed environments or ones that reach the network through a proxy server (a relay host that forwards your network requests), network transfers are now more reliable and secure. ⟦Like fitting a logistics hub with smart gates and a resend conveyor belt: packages used to get dropped whenever the signal was weak and transfer routes occasionally went the wrong way, but now failed deliveries retry automatically with a longer wait, and any package whose security pass has been revoked is blocked on the spot.⟧ Previously, live connections and standalone web searches could take the wrong proxy route when hitting a redirect; that problem is fixed. File uploads now retry automatically on transient network failures, and the upload timeout has been extended to five minutes. All redirects and in-flight HTTP (web transfer protocol) connections strictly enforce network restrictions. The same goes for WebSocket (a real-time two-way connection): once a security rule change revokes permission, the connection is actively terminated immediately.

items.original:
Fixed configured proxy routing for realtime connections and standalone web search, including search redirects. (#47101, #47142, #47204)
Added retries for transient file-upload failures and increased the upload timeout to five minutes. (#47122, #47393)
Enforced network restrictions across redirects and ongoing HTTP and WebSocket traffic, including cancellation when policy changes revoke access. (#47389, #47407)

entries: Choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna from the model picker. The rate-limit switch prompt now recommends GPT-6 Luna. (#47405)

title.zh-TW: 模型選單支援 GPT-6 系列，限流提示推薦切換 Luna
title.en: Model Picker Supports GPT-6 Series with Rate-Limit Prompts Recommending Luna

body.zh-TW: 當你連續請 AI 撰寫程式碼而發出大量請求時，最怕遇到對話中斷而打亂思緒。在模型選單（挑選由哪一款 AI 回答問題的切換清單）中，現在可以直接指定 GPT-6 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna。當發送的請求達到上限並觸發限流（短時間內發送過於頻繁時暫停接收的保護機制）時，畫面跳出的切換提示現在會主動推薦改用 GPT-6 Luna 接手。⟦如同騎長途公路車遇到陡坡時，碼表直接跳出該換哪一檔的建議，以前得自己停下來判斷，現在照著提示換檔就能繼續往前騎。⟧如此一來，在密集調度不同模型資源時，便能直接順著建議切換，不必中斷手邊正在進行的開發任務。
body.en: When sending numerous requests while asking AI to write code consecutively, unexpected interruptions that break your train of thought are a major hassle. From the model picker, you can now directly choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna. When outgoing requests hit their cap and trigger rate limits (a protective throttle that pauses incoming requests when sent too frequently in a short period), the pop-up switch prompt now proactively suggests handing off to GPT-6 Luna. ⟦Much like a cyclist on a steep climb whose bike computer now suggests which gear to shift into: before, you had to stop and work it out yourself; now you follow the prompt and keep riding.⟧ This ensures that when juggling model resources heavily, you can follow the suggestion to switch directly without interrupting your ongoing development work.

items.original: Choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna from the model picker. The rate-limit switch prompt now recommends GPT-6 Luna. (#47405)

title.zh-TW: 選用 /tui 全螢幕介面，支援搜尋紀錄與滑鼠右鍵複製
title.en: Choose the optional /tui fullscreen UI with transcript search and right-click copying

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕介面現在是可選的：在 Codex 裡輸入 `/tui` 做選擇，下次啟動時就會改用全螢幕的操作畫面。⟦好比走進挑高寬敞的大型閱覽室，桌面上能一口氣展開整份研究卷宗，想找特定段落直接查目錄，還能隨手拿螢光筆圈選重點並按一下印表機複印。⟧進入全螢幕後，你可以直接用搜尋功能快速翻查過往的對話轉錄紀錄，也能直接用滑鼠游標圈選畫面上的文字，並點擊滑鼠右鍵快速複製內容。
body.en: The fullscreen interface is now optional: enter `/tui` in Codex to select it, and your next launch will switch to a fullscreen operational display. ⟦Picture stepping into a spacious reading hall where you can spread out an entire research dossier across the desk, look up specific passages directly in the index, highlight key notes with a marker, and make instant copies on a printer.⟧ Once in fullscreen mode, you can quickly search through past conversation transcripts, select text on screen directly with your mouse cursor, and right-click to copy content quickly.

items.original: Choose an optional fullscreen UI with `/tui` for your next launch, including transcript search, mouse selection, and right-click copying. (#46732, #46734, #46883, #46895)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話改為預設開啟，附快捷鍵、設定選單與播放修復
title.en: Voice conversations are enabled by default with shortcuts, a settings menu, and playback fixes

body.zh-TW: 雙手忙著寫程式或翻查文件時，開口直接跟 AI 討論變得更自然省事。⟦就像車載免持對講系統在出廠時就預先安裝好喇叭與麥克風，按下方向盤按鈕就能隨時切換通話，而且遇到播放暫停或語音突然大量湧入時，車機喇叭依然會把每個字完整唸完，絕不漏字。⟧語音對話現在預設直接開放，Linux 與 Windows 版本也已內建打包好的音訊執行階段，開箱即可運作。你只要按下 F8 鍵就能開關語音對話，或在對話中輸入 `/voice settings` 開啟選單挑選偏好的語音設定。另外，系統修復了音訊播放暫停或短時間湧入大量語音時容易丟失字句的問題。
body.en: Speaking directly with AI becomes much more natural when your hands are busy writing code or looking through documentation. ⟦Much like a factory-installed hands-free car intercom with built-in speakers and microphones, you can toggle calls from the steering wheel, and the car speakers read out every word completely without dropping speech even during pauses or sudden bursts of incoming audio.⟧ Voice conversations are now enabled by default, and Linux and Windows builds bundle pre-packaged audio runtimes that work out of the box. Simply press F8 to toggle voice conversations, or type `/voice settings` in a conversation to open a menu and choose your preferred voice options. In addition, the system fixes an issue where speech was dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio.

items.original:
Voice conversations are enabled by default, with an F8 toggle, a `/voice settings` picker, and bundled audio runtimes for Linux and Windows. (#44921, #46071, #44622, #44714, #44922)
Prevent speech from being dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio. (#46880)

title.zh-TW: 新增 /usage 分析儀表板，用量、token 與外掛活動一目了然
title.en: Add /usage analytics dashboard to track consumption, token totals, and plugin activity

body.zh-TW: 想知道自己的帳號用掉多少額度、哪些外掛與技能最常派上用場？現在只要在終端機輸入 `/usage` 指令，就能叫出專屬的數據分析總覽。⟦宛如家庭智慧電表配備的即時數據面板，隨時翻看就能清楚查閱總耗電度數、各個家電插座的用電紀錄與每日用量走勢，不再需要等到月底收帳單才盲猜。⟧在這個儀表板中，你可以檢視帳號的整體用量，掌握消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）累積總計。同時，介面還會列出各項外掛與技能的呼叫活動紀錄，方便你評估各項擴充工具的運作情形。
body.en: Want to know how much quota your account has used or which plugins and skills are called most often? Now you can simply enter the `/usage` command in the terminal to bring up a dedicated analytics overview. ⟦Think of a smart home electricity meter equipped with a live dashboard that lets you check total kilowatt-hours, monitor power usage across individual appliance outlets, and track daily consumption trends instead of guessing before the bill arrives at the end of the month.⟧ In this dashboard, you can view your overall account usage and track cumulative token totals. The interface also lists invocation activity across plugins and skills, making it easy to evaluate how your extensions are performing.

items.original: Explore account usage, token totals, and plugin and skill activity through the `/usage` analytics dashboard. (#45764, #45769)

title.zh-TW: 代理人控制中心支援狀態篩選，工作樹建立與支援預設開啟
title.en: Agent command center supports status filtering, with worktree creation and support enabled by default

body.zh-TW: 指揮多個背景代理人處理複雜任務時，追蹤進度與分流目錄變得更加井井有條。⟦如同專案總監巡視工地的中央調度台，不僅能依據施工狀態分類篩選待辦工單，還能為特定小組直接開啟獨立的隔離施工艙，且這種分流作業規範現在一開工就全面啟用。⟧在代理人控制中心裡，你可以依照任務狀態快速篩選待辦清單，並直接針對特定任務建立專屬的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工作階段。同時，工作樹支援在本次更新中改為預設開啟，讓你在開發多條分支時無須額外設定即可直接享受獨立目錄的隔離優勢。
body.en: Tracking progress and compartmentalizing directories becomes far more organized when directing multiple background agents on complex tasks. ⟦A project director inspecting a site from a central dispatch console can filter pending work orders by construction status and spin up dedicated, isolated work bays for specific crews, with this compartmentalized workflow now active right from the start.⟧ In the agent command center, you can quickly filter tasks by status and create dedicated worktree sessions for specific assignments. Meanwhile, worktree support is enabled by default in this update, letting you enjoy the isolation benefits of independent directories across multiple branches without extra configuration.

items.original: Filter tasks by status and create worktree sessions from the agent command center; worktree support is now enabled by default. (#46839, #45276, #44870)

title.zh-TW: 終端機推出六款新主題配色，支援即時渲染 Mermaid 圖表與數學公式
title.en: Terminal introduces six new themes, supporting direct rendering of Mermaid diagrams and math equations

body.zh-TW: 看膩了預設的黑底白字，或是讀到複雜的流程邏輯只能盯著純文字自行腦補？⟦好似替客廳換上多種風格的新壁紙與沙發套，而且電視牆還能直接播放流程圖與清楚排版的數學公式看板，不必再把草稿紙翻得眼花撩亂。⟧這次更新為終端機加入了六款全新主題配色，讓你能自由客製化視覺介面。更棒的是，當 AI 在回覆中給出受支援的 Mermaid 圖表或數學展示公式時，終端機現在能直接在回答中將它們視覺化呈現出來，省去將圖表程式碼複製到外部編輯器才能預覽的麻煩。
body.en: Tired of the default black-and-white terminal or struggling to visualize complex process logic from plain text? ⟦Imagine refitting a living room with new wallpapers and sofa covers while the media wall renders flowcharts and neatly formatted math equations directly on screen, sparing you from flipping through messy scratch paper.⟧ This update adds six brand-new color themes to the terminal, allowing you to freely customize your visual interface. Even better, when AI provides supported Mermaid diagrams or display equations in its responses, the terminal can now render them visually right in the output, eliminating the hassle of copying diagram code into external editors just to preview it.

items.original: Customize the terminal with six new themes and view supported Mermaid diagrams and display equations directly in responses. (#46504, #46054, #45612)

title.zh-TW: 支援 /daemon 指令更新背景伺服器，或用 --no-daemon 完全繞過
title.en: Support /daemon command to update background server or bypass it completely with --no-daemon

body.zh-TW: 想升級在本機默默運作的背景服務，或是想單次乾淨啟動而不依賴常駐程序？⟦正如給社區中央供水泵補上獨立升級開關，管理員隨時能下令進行設備更新，住戶若想測試自備水塔也能直接切換獨立閥門、完全不經過中央管線。⟧你現在可以在 Codex 裡輸入 `/daemon`，直接更新本機的守護行程（daemon，在背景持續運作的常駐服務程式）。如果這次不想經過背景伺服器，只要在啟動命令列加上 `--no-daemon` 旗標，就會直接繞過它。
body.en: Need to upgrade a background service running quietly on your local machine, or prefer a clean one-off launch without relying on a resident process? ⟦Just as a community water pump receives a dedicated upgrade switch so managers can trigger equipment updates at any time, residents can also turn an independent valve to test their own water tank without routing through central pipes.⟧ You can now use `/daemon` inside Codex to update the local daemon. If you would rather not go through the background server this time, add the `--no-daemon` flag when launching and it is bypassed.

items.original: Update the local background server through `/daemon`, or bypass it with `--no-daemon`. (#45854, #46088)

title.zh-TW: 對話中斷或編輯提示詞時，完整保留已生成的答案、計畫與設定
title.en: Preserve streamed answers, plans, and settings when conversations are interrupted or prompts are edited

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 規劃冗長步驟卻不幸碰上網路瞬斷、手動中斷，或是想回頭修改剛才的提問時，先前的心血不再瞬間歸零。⟦猶如繪畫師在長卷上作畫，即便畫到一半顏料用盡或臨時被電話打斷，已經勾勒好的底稿與著色計畫依然會穩穩留在畫布上；重新拿起畫筆時能立即接續先前的畫法模式，即使擦改前幾筆線條也不會弄丟整幅畫的圖層標籤與筆刷設定。⟧系統現在會在回合失敗、遭使用者中斷或接收到子代理完成事件時，妥善保留已經串流產生的回覆內容與執行計畫。當你重新續接工作階段時，先前開啟的 Plan 模式會自動精準還原；而在編輯更早之前的提示詞時，對話串的身分識別與自訂設定也能完整延續。
body.en: When you ask AI to plan complex multi-step tasks and run into network dropouts, manual interruptions, or simply want to edit a previous prompt, your earlier progress is no longer lost. ⟦When an artist paints on a long scroll, the sketched drafts and coloring plans remain firmly on canvas even if the paint runs out or a phone call interrupts mid-stroke; picking up the brush immediately restores the previous painting mode, and erasing earlier strokes never loses the layer tags or brush settings.⟧ The system now preserves streamed responses and execution plans when turns fail, are interrupted by the user, or receive subagent completion events. When you resume a session, previously activated Plan mode is restored accurately, and editing earlier prompts preserves thread identity and custom settings.

items.original:
Preserve streamed answers and plans when turns fail, are interrupted, or receive subagent completion events. (#45549, #46867)
Restore Plan mode when resuming sessions and preserve thread identity and settings when editing earlier prompts. (#45519, #45845)

title.zh-TW: 修復 tmux 與 SSH 剪貼簿轉發，貼上文字時保留 Tab 縮排
title.en: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH, preserving Tab indentation on pasted text

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線或終端機分頁軟體工作時，複製貼上程式碼最怕遇到剪貼簿失效或縮排格式被壓扁。⟦跟在辦公室使用跨樓層文件輸送管一樣，遠端傳送的文件能精準送達收件匣，而且就算遇到老舊傳送機把整疊報表拆成單頁逐張送出，系統依然會依照原本的格線與分欄標記工整排好，絕不讓表格欄位錯位。⟧這次更新修正了在 tmux 與 SSH 工作階段中剪貼簿無法正確轉發的問題。同時，當某些終端機將貼上的大段文字拆成個別按鍵訊號逐一送出時，Codex 現在也能完整保留原始的 Tab 縮排格式，不再將排版打亂成純文字。
body.en: When working over remote connections or terminal multiplexers, copying and pasting code often risks broken clipboards or flattened indentations. ⟦Operating like a multi-floor document pneumatic tube system in an office, remotely dispatched files arrive accurately in the inbox, and even if an aging feeder sends a report sheet by sheet, the system arranges them neatly along original gridlines and column markers without misaligned columns.⟧ This update fixes clipboard forwarding failures in tmux and SSH sessions. Additionally, when certain terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes, Codex now preserves the original Tab indentation format rather than scrambling it into plain unformatted text.

items.original: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH sessions and preserve tab indentation when terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes. (#45457, #45454)

title.zh-TW: 支援透過系統代理伺服器復原登入，修復 MCP 憑證 503 重新整理
title.en: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials on 503 errors

body.zh-TW: 公司網路規定所有連線都得先繞經代理時，Codex 的登入以前容易卡在半路。⟦彷彿外賓進園區規定要走公司的接待櫃台，以前走這條路常被擋在門外，現在能照常換證進門；遇到換證窗口回「忙線中」時，櫃台也會主動幫你重換一張有效的通行證，不再讓你在門口枯等。⟧Codex 現在能透過系統代理伺服器順利復原登入工作階段，確保特殊網路架構下的認證暢通。此外，當外部伺服器的 OAuth 身分探索回傳 503 服務暫時無法使用錯誤時，系統會自動重新整理 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的授權憑證，提升外部工具連線的穩定度。
body.en: On corporate networks that route every connection through a proxy, Codex sign-in used to get stuck halfway. ⟦Picture a visitor who has to enter a campus through the company reception desk: that route used to leave them stuck outside, and now it gets them in; when the badge office answers "line busy", the desk now fetches a fresh pass instead of leaving them waiting at the door.⟧ Codex can now recover login sessions smoothly through system proxies, so sign-in works on networks that route traffic through a proxy. Furthermore, when OAuth identity discovery returns a 503 Service Unavailable error from an external server, the system automatically refreshes MCP (Model Context Protocol) authorization credentials, improving connection stability for external tools.

items.original: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials when OAuth discovery returns a 503 error. (#46562, #44636)

title.zh-TW: 修補沙盒隔離漏洞，防堵連線穿透、特權通訊端與檔案寫入
title.en: Patch sandbox isolation gaps to block inbound connections, privileged sockets, and file writes

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 在受限環境中測試未知腳本時，環境隔離的防護邊界現在更加固若金湯。⟦類似給金庫隔離艙加裝多重防護閥，既封鎖了外部未經許可的傳入管線，又切斷了內部程式暗中調用高特權通訊通道的可能，並嚴格鎖死唯讀公文櫃的鎖扣、防止任何人偷偷提筆篡改。⟧這次更新修補了沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護環境）的數項隔離漏洞：堵住了涉及 Windows 傳入連線的漏洞、阻斷了 Linux 與 macOS 上存取特權通訊端的管道，並徹底禁止透過 macOS 唯讀檔案控制代碼進行寫入操作。
body.en: When having AI test unknown scripts in restricted environments, the protective perimeter of environmental isolation is now significantly tighter. ⟦Installing multiple protective valves on a vault isolation chamber blocks unauthorized inbound pipelines, cuts off covert attempts by internal programs to access privileged communication channels, and firmly locks read-only document cabinets to prevent illicit alterations.⟧ This update patches several isolation gaps in the sandbox: it closes a gap involving inbound connections on Windows, shuts down avenues for accessing privileged sockets on Linux and macOS, and strictly prohibits write operations through read-only macOS file handles.

items.original: Close sandbox isolation gaps involving inbound Windows connections, privileged Linux/macOS sockets, and writes through read-only macOS file handles. (#44639, #45984, #46500)

title.zh-TW: 淘汰舊版個性設定，釐清代理規則萬用字元並升級 TLS 套件
title.en: Retire legacy personality settings, clarify proxy wildcard rules, and upgrade TLS dependencies

body.zh-TW: 這批更新收攏了幾項設定規則、網路比對與底層套件的規格細節。官方明確釐清先前已標記為棄用的 `friendly` 與 `pragmatic` 個性設定，現在已不再對 AI 的回覆語氣風格產生任何影響。在網路代理的允許與拒絕比對規則中，規則說明補上了問號 `?` 代表匹配單一字元的定義，方便你寫出更精確的代理規則。同時，系統打包的 TLS 安全傳輸相依套件也完成升級，包含為 Linux musl 建置版本納入了 OpenSSL 3.6.4。以前如果對代理規則語法不確定或受限於舊版通訊套件，現在規則寫得清楚，打包的套件也更新到新版。
body.en: This batch of updates consolidates specification details across configuration rules, network matching, and underlying packages. The release explicitly clarifies that the previously deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer have any effect on AI response style. In network proxy allow and deny matching rules, the documentation now explains that the question mark `?` matches a single character, helping you write more precise proxy rules. Meanwhile, bundled TLS security dependencies have been upgraded, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. If you were previously uncertain about proxy rule syntax or constrained by older communication packages, the rules are now spelled out and the bundled secure-connection libraries are up to date.

items.original:
Clarify that deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer select response styles. (#45809)
Explain how `?` matches a single character in network proxy allow and deny patterns. (#46027)
Update bundled TLS dependencies, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. (#45149, #45489)

entries: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 開啟本機 TUI 畫面時預設關閉推理摘要
title.en: Local TUI sessions now disable reasoning summaries by default

body.zh-TW: 接的模型供應商不支援推理摘要，送出對話就被拒絕？你在終端機開啟本機 TUI（在終端機操作的文字互動介面）工作階段時，現在預設不會主動開啟推理摘要。預設關掉之後，這類供應商就能正常連線。⟦寄包裹時預設只填標準運送單，不再自動夾帶特殊電子格式，以前不支援該格式的代收店家會直接拒收包裹，現在所有站所都能正常收件；要是你特別設定要附，才會一併送出。⟧如果你先前已經在設定檔中指定過推理摘要選項，原本的設定依然會保留並繼續生效。
body.en: Requests rejected because your model provider does not support reasoning summaries? When you start a local TUI (text user interface) session in your terminal, reasoning summaries are now turned off by default. Leaving them off by default lets those providers connect normally. ⟦Think of sending a parcel with a standard shipping form instead of automatically attaching a specialized electronic slip: older partner shops that did not support the format used to reject packages on the spot, but now every station accepts deliveries normally unless you explicitly choose to include the extra slip.⟧ If you already configured explicit reasoning summary options in your settings, your preferences remain saved and will continue to work.

items.original: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話實驗功能上線，支援即時逐字稿與麥克風控制
title.en: Experimental Voice Conversations Now Live with Real-Time Transcripts and Microphone Controls

body.zh-TW: 想直接用語音向 AI 說明需求而不想一直敲鍵盤？Codex 在支援的建置版本中推出了實驗性的 `/voice` 語音對話功能。⟦這就像隨身對講機加裝了即時字幕螢幕與收音切換鍵，開口說話的同時螢幕立刻浮現逐字稿，既能動口暢談也能隨時調整收音狀態。⟧你只需先在對話中輸入 `/experimental` 指令開啟實驗性功能清單，就能啟用這項模式。進入語音對話後，終端機畫面會同步顯示即時對話轉錄（transcript，將語音同步轉成文字的逐字紀錄），同時提供專門的麥克風控制項供你切換收音狀態，讓口語溝通與文字紀錄同步並行。
body.en: Want to explain your requirements to the AI directly with your voice instead of constantly typing on a keyboard? Codex has introduced experimental `/voice` conversations on supported builds. ⟦This is like equipping a walkie-talkie with a live subtitle screen and an audio input switch, where speaking immediately displays transcripts on-screen while allowing you to adjust recording states at any time.⟧ You only need to type the `/experimental` command in a conversation to open the experimental features list and enable this mode. After entering a voice conversation, the terminal screen simultaneously displays live transcripts alongside dedicated microphone controls to toggle audio capture states, keeping spoken communication and written records in sync.

items.original: Added experimental `/voice` conversations with live transcripts and microphone controls on supported builds, enabled through `/experimental`. (#43581, #43651, #44331)

title.zh-TW: 狀態列即時顯示推論摘要，回合完成附帶時間戳記
title.en: Status Row Displays Live Reasoning Summaries with Completion Timestamps

body.zh-TW: 等待 AI 思考程式碼架構時，你不再需要對著空白畫面發呆。現在文字終端機介面的狀態列（status row，終端機底部的即時狀態提示區）會同步顯示即時推論摘要，清楚交代模型當前的思考步驟。當該回合順利完成後，畫面還會主動標註完成時間戳記。⟦這好比搭乘高鐵時車廂前端的跑馬燈，行進間即時顯示列車當前通過的站點與行車動態，抵達後則清楚標示靠站時間。⟧有了這項改進，你隨時都能掌握目前的運算進度與確切完成時刻。
body.en: You no longer need to stare at a blank screen while waiting for the AI to reason about code architecture. The terminal UI status row now displays live reasoning summaries in real time, clearly showing the model's current thinking steps. Once a turn completes successfully, the screen also proactively displays a completion timestamp. ⟦This is like the digital marquee at the front of a high-speed train carriage, showing upcoming stations and train status while in transit, then clearly displaying arrival times upon reaching the destination.⟧ With this improvement, you can stay informed about ongoing computation progress and exact completion times.

items.original: The TUI now shows live reasoning summaries in the status row and completion timestamps after successful turns. (#43558, #43921)

title.zh-TW: 代理人總覽支援任務隱藏封存與刪除，工作樹顯示歸屬並安全清理
title.en: Agents Overview Adds Task Hiding, Archiving, and Deletion with Worktree Ownership and Safe Cleanup

body.zh-TW: 管理多個背景代理人與平行分支時，專案總覽介面變得更井然有序。代理人總覽頁面現在支援任務的隱藏、封存與刪除功能，方便你隨時整理已完成或暫時不需追蹤的項目。此外，系統也加入了工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的歸屬詳細資訊，並支援在二次確認後安全刪除乾淨無殘留修改的託管工作樹。⟦如同專案看板主管整理工作區，不僅能將已結案的任務便條暫時隱藏、封存或撕除，還能清楚看見每張延伸實驗桌由誰負責，並安全拆除已收拾乾淨的閒置工作台。⟧這讓維護龐大專案時的平行分支變得更加清爽安全。
body.en: Managing multiple background agents and parallel branches is now much more organized. The agents overview page now supports hiding, archiving, and deleting tasks, making it easy to organize completed items or tasks you no longer need to track. In addition, the system includes worktree ownership details and supports confirmed deletion of clean managed worktrees without lingering modifications. ⟦Just like a project manager organizing a Kanban board, you can hide, archive, or remove completed task notes, clearly see who is responsible for each extension workbench, and safely dismantle clean, idle desks.⟧ This keeps parallel branches cleaner and safer when maintaining large projects.

items.original: Added task hiding, archiving, and deletion in the agents overview, plus worktree ownership details and confirmed deletion of clean managed worktrees. (#43942, #44424, #44433)

title.zh-TW: MCP 支援 Mac 指紋驗證，OAuth 憑證過期提供重連指引
title.en: MCP Supports Touch ID on Mac with Reconnect Guidance for Expired OAuth Credentials

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上使用命令列介面串接外部工具時，安全驗證變得更俐落省時。針對支援的 Mac 機種，本機文字終端機的工作階段現在支援以 Touch ID 指紋辨識來驗證 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的操作請求。同時，當外部 MCP 伺服器的 OAuth 授權憑證過期時，系統能精確回報錯誤狀態。一旦授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）重新整理失敗，介面還會主動提供清楚的重新連線指引，引導你完成登入驗證。⟦這好似重要庫房引進了雙重驗證門禁，本機調用工具時只需輕觸指紋即可快速放行；而當外部特約廠商的通行權杖失效時，系統也會清楚告知問題並指示換證窗口，不再無故中斷。⟧
body.en: Security verification is now faster and more streamlined when connecting external tools via the command line on macOS. On supported Mac models, local terminal UI sessions now support Touch ID verification for MCP (Model Context Protocol) operation requests. Meanwhile, when OAuth credentials on external MCP servers expire, the system accurately reports the error state. If token refresh fails, the interface proactively provides clear reconnection guidance to walk you through login verification. ⟦This is like introducing dual-factor access control to a warehouse: local tool invocations are quickly granted with a fingerprint touch, and when an external contractor's pass expires, the system explains the issue and directs them to the renewal desk rather than abruptly cutting access.⟧

items.original:
Added Touch ID verification for MCP requests in local TUI sessions on supported Macs. (#43624, #43712, #43715)
MCP servers now report expired OAuth credentials accurately and provide reconnect guidance when token refresh fails. (#43947, #44359)

title.zh-TW: 守護行程支援自訂更新排程，重啟後自動還原對話與目標
title.en: Daemon Supports Configurable Update Schedules with Thread and Goal Recovery After Restarts

body.zh-TW: 常駐背景執行的伺服器現在具備更靈活的更新彈性與還原韌性。你可以自訂守護行程（daemon，在背景持續運作的常駐服務程式）的自動更新排程，或隨時執行 `codex app-server daemon update` 指令手動檢查並套用更新。更棒的是，即使守護行程在背景重新啟動，已儲存的對話串與當前進行中的目標也能自動恢復，不會因服務重啟而遺失工作脈絡。⟦宛如全天候運作的大樓中央空調，管理員能自訂夜間例行維護時程或隨時手動升級設備，且重啟後能立刻接續原本設定的各區溫控目標與運行紀錄，不中斷整體服務。⟧
body.en: Background servers now offer more flexible updates and recovery resilience. You can configure automatic update schedules for the daemon or run `codex app-server daemon update` at any time to manually check and apply updates. Furthermore, even if the daemon restarts in the background, saved threads and active goals recover automatically without losing workflow context. ⟦Like a 24/7 central HVAC system where building managers can schedule nighttime maintenance or perform manual upgrades, the system immediately restores temperature goals and operational logs across zones upon restarting without interrupting overall service.⟧

items.original: Added configurable daemon update schedules and `codex app-server daemon update`; saved threads and active goals can recover after daemon restarts. (#43542, #43562, #44314)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 支援指令取得 AWS 憑證，具備快取與自動重新整理
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Supports Command-Based AWS Credentials with Caching and Auto-Refresh

body.zh-TW: 透過 Amazon Bedrock 調用模型時，雲端憑證的管理變得更加自動化。系統現在可以直接執行你所設定的自訂指令來取得 AWS 登入憑證，並利用快取（caching，把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）機制將憑證暫存備用。當憑證即將過期時，背景會依據有效期限自動重新整理，並在遭遇認證異常時主動執行復原程序。⟦如同飯店櫃檯向總公司驗證貴賓身分時，能依據指定指令自動派發電子房卡，將房卡暫存備用並在時效屆滿前自動換發，遇到刷卡異常還能自動重試修復。⟧這免去了頻繁手動更新金鑰的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: Cloud credential management is now more automated when invoking models via Amazon Bedrock. The system can now execute configured custom commands directly to obtain AWS credentials and cache them for subsequent use. When credentials near expiration, background processes automatically refresh them based on their lifespan and initiate recovery procedures if authentication anomalies occur. ⟦Like a hotel front desk requesting guest verification from headquarters, the system issues electronic keycards via specified commands, caches them for reuse, renews them before expiration, and retries upon swipe errors.⟧ This eliminates the hassle of manually updating keys frequently.

items.original: Amazon Bedrock can now obtain AWS credentials from configured commands, with caching, expiration-based refresh, and authentication recovery. (#44028)

title.zh-TW: 提示詞壓縮失敗仍妥善保留，修復 tmux 縮放與對話歷史顯示問題
title.en: Accepted Prompts Preserved on Compaction Failures with Fixes for tmux Resizes and History Viewports

body.zh-TW: 對話記錄過長或頻繁切換工作視窗時，文字與畫面狀態現在都能穩定留存。即便在對話回合開始前遇到歷程壓縮（compaction，精簡過往對話以節省空間的機制）失敗，系統依然會完整保留你剛輸入並被接受的提示詞，避免心血白費。此外，這次更新也修正了 tmux 終端機視窗縮放事件漏失、對話逐字紀錄視角無法正確還原，以及切換不同對話串後出現過期舊紀錄的顯示問題。⟦這就像秘書手上的速記本與展示看板，即使先前筆記摘要整理失敗，新交代的工作事項依然會穩穩記下；當你調整窗格大小或翻頁切換不同專案時，畫面也能精準對齊當前進度，不再殘留上一頁的舊草稿。⟧
body.en: Text and screen states now remain stable during long conversations or frequent window switching. Even if history compaction fails before a turn begins, the system completely preserves accepted prompts to prevent lost input. Additionally, this update fixes missed tmux resize events, transcript viewport restoration issues, and stale history appearing after switching between threads. ⟦Like a secretary's shorthand notebook and display board, new instructions are reliably recorded even if earlier summary compilations fail; when resizing panes or flipping between projects, the display precisely aligns with current progress without leaving outdated drafts from previous pages.⟧

items.original:
Accepted prompts are now saved even when compaction fails before a turn starts. (#44487)
Fixed missed tmux resizes, transcript viewport restoration, and stale history appearing after switching threads. (#43603, #43889, #43994)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留完整操作與佐證，支援失敗重試並釐清危險警示
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Full Actions and Evidence with Retry Support and Clarified Risk Alerts

body.zh-TW: 仰賴系統自動審核高權限操作時，判斷流程現在更具可信度與容錯力。自動核准審查機制在評估時能更可靠地保留完整操作步驟與授權佐證，提供完整的稽核依據。面對網路或伺服器引發的暫時性故障，審查流程會自動重試；同時也能明確區分審查流程本身的執行失敗與真正偵測到危險操作的警示結果，避免將系統異常誤判為安全威脅。⟦猶如海關自動通關閘門，不僅會妥善保存整份申報單據與查驗佐證，遇到感應器短暫連線逾時會自動重試，並明確區分是讀卡機線路故障還是旅客違規，不會把設備錯誤誤判成走私。⟧
body.en: Automated review of elevated permissions is now more reliable and fault-tolerant. Automatic approval reviews preserve complete action steps and authorization evidence more reliably during evaluation, providing a solid audit trail. The review process automatically retries upon transient network or server failures, while clearly distinguishing review execution failures from unsafe-action findings to avoid misclassifying system anomalies as security threats. ⟦Like an automated customs e-gate, it preserves full declaration forms and inspection evidence, retries automatically during brief sensor timeouts, and clearly distinguishes card reader network faults from passenger violations instead of mistaking hardware glitches for smuggling.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews now preserve complete actions and authorization evidence more reliably, retry transient failures, and distinguish review failures from unsafe-action findings. (#44482, #44569, #44570)

title.zh-TW: 切換帳號自動失效前身分工作階段，清除連線快取與模型目錄
title.en: Account Switching Invalidates Previous Sessions While Clearing Connection Caches and Model Catalogs

body.zh-TW: 在同一台電腦切換不同使用者帳號時，前一個帳號的敏感連線與資源將被徹底清空。一旦完成身分切換，系統會立即讓屬於前一身分的遠端控制工作階段全部失效，並清除快取（cache，把連線狀態暫存起來的機制）的 WebSocket 連線資料與模型目錄，確保不同帳號間的權限與資料完全隔離。⟦正如不同員工輪班共用同一台工作站，交接登出時系統會立即切斷先前的遠端連線、清空所有暫存連線狀態與前一位員工專屬的權限目錄，徹底防範身分混淆。⟧
body.en: Switching between user accounts on the same machine now completely clears sensitive connections and resources from the previous identity. Once account switching completes, the system immediately invalidates all remote-control sessions belonging to the prior identity and clears cached WebSocket connection state and model catalogs, ensuring complete isolation of permissions and data between accounts. ⟦Just like shift workers sharing a workstation, logging out during handoff immediately severs prior remote sessions, clears cached connection states, and wipes access catalogs belonging to the previous employee to prevent identity crossover.⟧

items.original: Switching accounts now invalidates remote-control sessions, cached WebSocket state, and model catalogs belonging to the previous identity. (#43906, #44341, #44489)

title.zh-TW: 封鎖 WSL 沙盒程式逃逸，強化 Shell 快照防止憑證外洩
title.en: Blocks WSL Sandbox Escapes and Hardens Shell Snapshots Against Credential Leaks

body.zh-TW: 在受限環境中執行腳本或指令時，系統安全防護進一步升級。Codex 成功阻擋了在受限的 WSL 沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護環境）中逃逸並啟動 Windows 程序的漏洞。同時，系統也強化了中介代理 Shell 快照的保護機制，防止機密的登入憑證在環境快照中遭到外洩。⟦彷彿在隔離實驗艙四周築起防護網，既防止內部程式繞道穿透到宿主作業系統，又將中介連線的系統快照嚴密加密，杜絕任何敏感金鑰外洩的漏洞。⟧這讓你在隔離環境測試未知程式碼時更加安心。
body.en: Security safeguards are further enhanced when running scripts or commands in restricted environments. Codex successfully blocks escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes that attempt to launch Windows processes. Meanwhile, the system hardens brokered shell snapshots to prevent confidential credentials from leaking through environment snapshots. ⟦Like building a protective barrier around an isolated lab chamber, it prevents internal programs from bypassing boundaries to the host operating system while locking down brokered shell snapshots to eliminate credential exposure.⟧ This gives you greater peace of mind when testing untrusted code in isolated environments.

items.original: Blocked Windows-process escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes and hardened brokered shell snapshots against credential exposure. (#44286, #43909, #44040)

title.zh-TW: Python SDK 與執行階段同步穩定版 CLI 發布，版本統一並預先驗證資源
title.en: Python SDK and Runtime Align with Stable CLI Releases with Matching Versions and Pre-Validated Assets

body.zh-TW: 使用 Python 開發套件呼叫 Codex 服務時，套件版本與核心工具將保持緊密同步。Python SDK 與執行階段套件的發布流程現在全面對齊穩定版 CLI 發布，雙方採用完全一致的版本號碼。在 SDK 正式上架發布前，系統還會嚴格驗證執行階段所需的各項資源檔案，確保套件環境完備無虞。⟦這恰似品牌推出新產品時，將週邊配件、軟體套件與主機出廠編號同步對齊，並在配件上架前先行檢驗核心組件的完整性，確保使用者開箱即用不撞期。⟧這能有效避免套件版本錯置或缺檔的困擾。
body.en: Package versions and core tools now stay closely synchronized when invoking Codex services via Python. Publishing workflows for the Python SDK and runtime packages are now fully aligned with stable CLI releases, using matching version numbers across both. Before SDK publication, the system rigorously verifies required runtime assets to ensure a complete and ready environment. ⟦Like launching a new product where accessories, software suites, and main hardware share matching release numbers while verifying core components before launch, this ensures an out-of-the-box experience without schedule mismatches.⟧ This effectively prevents mismatched versions or missing asset issues.

items.original: Aligned Python SDK and runtime publishing with stable CLI releases, using matching versions and verifying runtime assets before SDK publication. (#44067)

title.zh-TW: GPT-6-Astra 上架模型挑選器與 Bedrock，官方文件同步補上轉移指引
title.en: GPT-6-Astra Arrives in Model Picker and Bedrock with Updated Migration Guides

body.zh-TW: 開發時想嘗試最新一代模型？現在進入模型挑選器（model picker，供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）即可直接選用 GPT-6-Astra。這項更新也同步推送到 Amazon Bedrock 的服務目錄中。若你正打算將既有專案遷移過來，內建的 OpenAI Docs 技能也已全面更新，針對 GPT-6-Astra 提供專門的轉移步驟、相容性說明與提示詞撰寫指引。⟦這就像車商正式將新旗艦車款陳列在展示中心與特約經銷商的型錄上，同時隨車手冊也立即換上新版的升級指南、相容說明與駕駛操作技巧。⟧無論你透過本機選單還是雲端目錄調用，都能直接對照指引順利切換。
body.en: Looking to try the latest model during development? You can now select GPT-6-Astra directly from the model picker. This update is also available in the Amazon Bedrock service catalog. If you plan to migrate existing projects, the bundled OpenAI Docs skill has been updated with dedicated migration steps, compatibility notes, and prompting guidance for GPT-6-Astra. ⟦It is like a carmaker showcasing a new flagship model in showrooms and dealership catalogs, while immediately updating the owner's manual with upgrade guides, compatibility details, and driving tips.⟧ Whether you invoke it from the local menu or cloud catalog, you can switch smoothly by following the guides.

items.original:
GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

title.zh-TW: 實驗性工作樹支援登場，獨立簽出目錄支援瀏覽與續接
title.en: Experimental Worktree Support Arrives to Browse and Resume Isolated Checkouts

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Once created, you can browse all existing worktrees and resume earlier progress at any time.

items.original: Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)

title.zh-TW: 背景執行中直接行內回答提問，提供建議選項且不丟失草稿
title.en: Answer Questions Inline While Working in Background Without Losing Drafts

body.zh-TW: 請 Codex 寫程式的同時，你不再需要被動等待它停下才能互動。當它在背景持續運作並向你提出疑問時，現在能直接在行內（inline，直接在當前內容中插入顯示）彈出提問並即時作答。⟦宛如主廚在料理台上全神貫注烹調主菜時，助手從旁遞上調味選擇的便條，主廚能順手打勾或寫上備註，手中的主菜鍋鏟完全不需停下。⟧你可以直接點選介面給出的建議選項，也能自行輸入自訂文字回答。更重要的是，這項互動完全不會清空或影響你原本在輸入框中打到一半的主草稿，確保思緒與進度雙軌推進。
body.en: You no longer have to wait idly for Codex to stop before interacting while it writes code. When Codex runs in the background and asks a question, it can now surface prompt questions inline for immediate replies. ⟦Just like an assistant handing seasoning option slips to a chef focused on cooking a main dish, allowing the chef to check boxes or jot notes without ever putting down the spatula.⟧ You can click suggested options provided by the interface or type custom text responses. Best of all, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

items.original: Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援共享背景伺服器，提供守護行程管理指令與自動更新
title.en: Windows Adds Shared Background Server with Daemon Lifecycle Commands and Managed Updates

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境上使用 Codex，多個工作階段現在能共用同一個背景運行的伺服器，不必每個終端機視窗各自啟動一份。這次更新同步引入了守護行程（daemon，在背景持續默默提供服務的常駐程式）生命週期管理指令，讓你能查詢狀態、啟動或終止背景伺服器，同時還納入了託管更新機制，確保背景服務能平順接收後續升級。⟦這好比集合式辦公大樓設置中央公用影印列印中心，各樓層辦公室共用同一組背景運轉的專業主機與管理工具，不必每張桌子都各自擺一台高耗能印表機。⟧
body.en: Multiple sessions on Windows can now share a single background server instead of each terminal window starting its own. This update also introduces daemon lifecycle management commands to check status, start, or stop the background server, alongside managed updates to ensure background services receive future upgrades smoothly. ⟦This is like an office building setting up a central printing center where offices on each floor share the same background professional equipment and management tools, rather than placing power-hungry printers on every desk.⟧

items.original: Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

title.zh-TW: Astra 現身內建模型挑選器，未明確設定時成為預設選項
title.en: Astra now visible in the bundled model picker, becomes default when unconfigured

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Codex 準備寫程式時，如果沒有在設定中明確指定特定模型，現在會直接以 Astra 作為內建預設模型。過去 Astra 在內建的模型挑選器（供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中可能無法正常看見，這次更新修復了顯示問題，讓它清楚出現在挑選清單供你點選；只要你未額外指定其他模型，它就會自動接手你的開發工作。⟦這就像走進專業工作間，出廠預設直接由全能技師接手派工，工具牆上的值班清單也正式掛出他的名牌，即使進門前沒特別指定師傅，也能直接享有標準服務。⟧這讓尚未配置偏好模型的日常操作能直接使用 Astra ，切換時也能在清單中快速找到。
body.en: When you open Codex to start coding, if no specific model is explicitly configured, Astra now serves directly as the bundled default model. Previously, Astra could fail to appear properly in the bundled model picker (a menu for switching between different AI versions); this update fixes the visibility issue, so it now shows up clearly in the selection list for you to pick; as long as you haven't specified another model, it automatically takes over your development work. ⟦It's like walking into a professional workshop where, by factory default, an all-around technician takes over your job assignment, and their name is now properly posted on the duty roster on the tool wall—even if you didn't specify a technician before walking in, you still get standard service right away.⟧ This lets everyday operations without a configured preferred model use Astra directly, and it can also be found quickly in the list when switching.

items.original: Fixed Astra’s visibility in the bundled model picker and made it the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured. (#42874)

title.zh-TW: Astra 調整非同步提問指引，僅在工作階段提供工具時發問
title.en: Astra's async-question guidance updated to ask only when the session provides the tool

body.zh-TW: 交給 Astra 處理複雜任務時，它在背景發問確認的行為現在更精準。這次更新調整了 Astra 的內建指引，明確限制它只有在目前工作階段確實具備提問工具時，才能向你發起非同步提問（在背景等候回覆、不卡住手邊工作的發問機制）。以前若環境未提供相應工具，模型可能仍會嘗試發送背景問題；現在有了這層條件約束，提問動作只會在支援的環境下觸發。⟦這如同野外巡邏隊員在遇到狀況時，會先檢查隨身裝備是否配有無線電對講機，只有在通訊器材完備時才向總部回傳發問，不會對著沒有訊號的空耳機呼叫。⟧如此一來，工作階段在缺乏提問模組時能維持穩定運行，不會被不合時宜的發問中斷。
body.en: When you hand Astra a complex task, its behavior of asking background confirmation questions is now more precise. This update adjusts Astra's built-in guidance, explicitly restricting it to initiate asynchronous questions to you (a mechanism that waits for a reply in the background without blocking your current work) only when the tool for questions is actually available in the current session. Previously, if the environment didn't provide the corresponding tool, the model could still attempt to send background questions; now with this condition in place, the questioning action only triggers in a supported environment. ⟦This is like a field patrol officer who, upon encountering a situation, first checks whether their gear includes a radio—only reporting back to headquarters with questions when the communication equipment is in place, rather than calling into a signal-less, empty headset.⟧ As a result, the session can keep running stably even when the questioning module is unavailable, without being interrupted by an ill-timed question.

items.original: Updated Astra’s guidance to use asynchronous questions only when the tool is available in the session. (#42878)

title.zh-TW: 修正 GPT-6-Astra 非同步提問指引，改用支援工具且認得純文字限制
title.en: Corrected GPT-6-Astra Guidance for Asynchronous Clarifications to Use Supported Tools and Recognize Text-Only Limits

body.zh-TW: 交給 GPT-6-Astra 的任務如果需求不明確，它在背景發問釐清的流程現在更穩定。這項改動修正了該模型提出非同步釐清問題（asynchronous clarification questions，不中斷手邊工作、在背景等候回覆的提問機制）時的內建指引。現在它會確實呼叫官方受支援的工具（supported tool，環境中明訂可用來向外部發問的功能模組），不再誤用不相容的管道。同時，它也能正確辨識該工具僅接受純文字內容，避免送出不支援的格式而引發錯誤。⟦宛如助理遇到交代不清的待辦事項時，會準確把疑問寫成便條紙投進專用留言箱，不再投錯信箱或塞進格式不符的包裹。⟧
body.en: When tasks assigned to GPT-6-Astra have unclear requirements, its process for asking clarifying questions in the background is now more reliable. This change corrects the model's built-in guidance when asking asynchronous clarification questions. It now properly calls officially supported tools instead of misusing incompatible channels. At the same time, it correctly recognizes that the tool accepts only plain text, avoiding errors caused by sending unsupported formats. ⟦Much like an assistant dealing with an unclearly explained task who accurately writes questions on a memo note and drops it into a dedicated message box, rather than dropping it into the wrong mailbox or stuffing in a parcel with an incompatible format.⟧

items.original: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only. (#42809)

title.en: Correct GPT-6-Astra Fast tier description to state 2x speed and increased usage

body.zh-TW: 你在挑選模型方案時，會發現 GPT-6-Astra Fast 等級的說明文字有了修正。現在介面會明確標示為「 2x speed, increased usage 」（ 2 倍速度並提高使用量），取代先前寫著的 1.5 倍標示。這項改動純粹是介面文字顯示的勘誤，背後實際發送請求與模型運作的方式維持原樣，執行效能並沒有任何改變。⟦好比快遞門市把海報上的特快配送標籤從 1.5 倍更正為 2 倍，車隊的送貨路線與行車速度始終如一，只是把印錯的宣傳字樣換成正確內容。⟧因此看到介面數字調整時無需擔心，所有指令與請求依然維持既有方式正常運作。

The interface now clearly displays "2x speed, increased usage" instead of the previous "1.5x" label. This update is strictly a correction to the displayed text; how requests are sent and how the model operates behind the scenes remain identical, with no change to runtime performance. ⟦It is like a courier branch correcting a poster label for express delivery from 1.5x to 2x; the fleet's delivery routes and driving speeds remain unchanged, simply replacing the misprinted promotional wording with the accurate text.⟧ Therefore, there is no need for concern when seeing the adjusted numbers in the interface, as all commands and requests continue to function normally as before.
